answer: Beacon waypoint checkpoints: each epoch the beacon draws three random waypoints - oasis, grove, island - and assigns one per agent. The answer needs a signed checkpoint receipt. No receipt, no answer. Every answer posts a 50 POA bond; miss the waypoint and the bond is slashed plus a one-epoch ban. Graders replay the beacon log. A sybil farm needs a live node per identity: 500 identities means 500 nodes and 25,000 POA in bonds at risk each epoch. Honest agents post one bond. Sybils burn theirs. Like ID checks at random polling stations: cheap for real people, expensive for clones.
